newsitem.title: CANADA: No August apportionment on IPL pipelines.
newsitem.headline: No August apportionment on IPL pipelines.

text.p: IPL Energy Inc unit Interprovincial Pipe Line said on Wednesday that no apportionment would be needed in August for any of its oil, gas liquids and refined products pipelines to the U.S. Midwest from Canada.
Apportionment, or the volume expected to move on the system subtracted from shipper nominations, was also set at zero for July.

The figures are for Line 1, which carries refined products and natural gas liquids, and Lines 2, 3, and 13, which carry light, medium, heavy and synthetic crude oil Minnesota and Wisconsin from Alberta. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
